title: Variable limits (limits)
interactive: /solve/set/limits → 4 numbers (the order and meaning of the positions are not documented in the KB)
notes: The KB records only the prompt Minimum allowable absolute pressure (in [Pa]) [1]; the semantics of the remaining positions (maximum pressure, min/max temperature) are inferred from the verified line and require verification. The default values here are an example, not a recommendation: substitute your own limits.
